basis.text: A project is due for rescoring once its score is 12 hours old (RESCORE_MIN_INTERVAL_HOURS); a newly recorded ship queues a rescore within the quarter hour. The next refresh is the latest expected time, not a promise: a backlog can delay it.

Repositories, release feeds and changelogs are re-read by refresh tier (HOT hourly, WARM every 6 hours, COOL daily, COLD every 3 days); the tier follows the activity status and the last meaningful ship. A failing source backs off. A reading is stale after 72 hours, or one and a half cadences of its tier where that is longer (108 hours on COLD).

statusMeaning.text: Quiet: the newest counted ship is older than the active window, on a source HEY can read.

rule.text: From meaningful, corroborated building events only — never price. SHIPPING: one within 7 days. ACTIVE: one within 30 days, or 2 within 45. QUIET: the newest within 60 days. DORMANT: nothing for longer, on a source HEY can read. RESUMED: activity within 14 days after a gap of 60+ that HEY watched — every comeback ship read from a source HEY was already reading when the gap began; otherwise the newest ship's own status. UNKNOWN: HEY holds no repository, changelog or feed it can read, or the activity it reads is recorded under another page, or every one it read is silent 21+ days with nothing counted since.

text.text: Repositories, changelogs and feeds HEY reads for this project, and the ship events recorded from them.
